name: ImageNet-A full cumulative trajectory BOB versus strong augmentation
vanilla_reference: existing post-after_task per-sample trajectory; no retraining

acquisition.SCC: original loss on real anchor only, coefficient=5
acquisition.S_auxiliary: second strong view of the same current real anchor
acquisition.BOB_auxiliary: uniform accepted current-task synthetic bank of anchor's class
acquisition.CA_rng: 1993 + task*100000; both branches; original CA otherwise unchanged

bob.template: an object photo of a {} in the {} background with the {} pose
bob.finetune_real_source: all current-task real train images; not 5-shot subsampling
bob.generator_reset: fresh pretrained diffusion model and fresh LoRA for every task
bob.context_bank: paired background/pose from current task only; sample independently of target class

decision.large_old_sacrifice: not numerically specified by prompt; report final/mean old delta, never claim automatic pass
decision.small_single_seed_gain: descriptive only; +0.1..0.2 pp is not strong evidence
